sections.location: /preview-qa — isolated preview-only responsive review helper

sections.location: Shared EvidenceBlock, SourceMethodology, blog and answer templates — review credits and methodology

claimsAndSources: Dragon Ride facts use the organiser’s 2026 reversed-route announcement and next-event update, with 2027 course uncertainty explicit. General preparation advice is identified as coaching guidance, with no invented research, individual result, event experience or dose. Existing coaching facts are retained; historical coaching-price research has not been refreshed. See docs/seo/roadman-search-trust-sprint-2026-09-07.md for URLs and the source discrepancy. USA Cycling qualification tiers and TrainingPeaks CTL/ATL/TSB definitions checked against primary documentation on 7 September. British Cycling directory and qualification pages were visible in search but direct fetches were blocked, so no unverified UK level hierarchy is asserted. Further sources and Semrush limitations are recorded in the sprint document. 8 September: Google link best practices and video structured-data guidance; YouTube embedded-player start documentation. Timestamp support is prepared without adding SeekToAction or unverified Clip markup.
examplesAndReasoning: The Dragon route comparison gives named historic options, distance, ascent and edition. UK/US rider enquiries are explicitly illustrative buying briefs, not client testimony or training prescriptions. The calculator gives explicit starting values, daily inputs, formulas, output timing and a worked rest-day example; its example weekly totals are demonstration data. Removed empty or unsupported verdicts and targets.
voiceAndCuts: Removed internal ownership prose, generic hero payoff, unsupported algorithm contrast, wrong event distances, W/kg pass marks, finish guarantees, obligatory stacked training, unverified weather statistics, blanket intake prescriptions, unattributed guest prescriptions and repeated closing slogans. Retained practical decisions and useful links. Further cuts remove internal Search Console/redirect prose, invented first-person coaching claims, incorrect USAC tiers and the calculator’s fixed race-ready/detrained diagnoses. Generation instructions now require directly supporting sources and allow insufficient evidence to produce no answer. Existing tests no longer require internal ownership wording. Further cuts cover six calculator descriptions and the shared internal funnel badge; no new human review credited.
desktopReview: Authenticated Vercel preview e3b1fb606e46e26162e5184b1e89db51d2a85983, viewport 1363x936 CSS pixels. Inspected coaching hero screenshot and rendered introduction; Dragon Ride race hero, all four route cards, sources and sidebar screenshots; training article hero, answer capsule and route-table screenshot; changed buyer-guide link paragraphs in both articles. Each of these five pages reported document width 1355px, with no horizontal overflow. The article route table is compact and readable; source/edition notices sit with their facts. Directory DOM confirms the 2026 Gran Fondo card, 222km/3,583m and no overflow; a final directory screenshot was interrupted by a browser connection reset, so a complete directory visual pass is not claimed. Rendered HTML tests cover the unchanged unrelated race layout and corrected related-card edition. Read-through and final editorial QA remain distinct from these checks. This observation applies only to the earlier code revision named above. The later country guides, CTL surfaces and archive passage edits have not yet completed rendered review on the new preview; that review is pending and must not be inferred from the earlier screenshots. The 8 September additions have passed code/rendered-markup tests, but interactive desktop review is still pending. The local browser initially lacked Chrome and its installer encountered a certificate error; no visual pass is claimed.
mobileReview: Not yet complete. The available browser exposes no viewport-resizing capability. Mobile rendered review remains required; responsive source inspection is not represented as a phone review.
productAndOfferAccuracy: No changes to live prices, membership inclusion, product availability, testimony or payment flow. New coaching copy reflects existing plan/team-review/group-call facts. Free resources link to /community/clubhouse; paid coaching links to /coaching and /apply. No live race database was updated or simulated course validated. UK/US guides retain US$195 Not Done Yet and US$525 Inner Circle, with individual-plan/team-review/group-call delivery distinguished from private coaching. No fixed international call availability or undocumented client geography is asserted.
